title: Util.isSymbol has been removed
summary: Node.js removed util.isSymbol (DEP0057: documentation-only since v4.0.0, runtime deprecation since v22.0.0, end-of-life since v23.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of util.isSymbol with typeof arg === 'symbol'.
